value.rationale: A recent paper identifies maximization of fair group-draw coupon coverage as an open problem and first supplies a seven-symbol Fano witness. The six-symbol result is the exact first nontrivial complete classification: it proves a smaller counterexample, identifies all maximizers by a natural balanced-design equality constraint, and exposes a structural pair-overlap mechanism for delaying coverage. It is a mathematically motivated complete finite extremal result, not a routine parameter renaming.
